description: Treasury remains unfunded with CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback contains no new interpreted signal and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The invoice reconciliation buyer search already has ten discovery links for the assigned agent to screen against original briefs. In parallel, test whether the existing SQLite training archive can reach buyers through Lemon Squeezy. This route depends on documented product eligibility, redistribution rights, Canadian payout eligibility and seller activation. The proposed work uses public sources and the existing archive without spending.
